notes.title: Steamdeck Performance Improvements, Reticle Changes and AI/Levelgen Optimization
notes.notes:
Update:
 Steamdeck loading and performance optimization.
 More visible targeting reticle cursor.
 AI spawning and levelgen improvements.
 Fixed sniper reticle on 16:10 resolutions.

notes.title: Sewage and Blood Update
notes.notes:
Update:
 New sewer elevated walkway tile.
 Adjusted sewer AI placement.
 Better blood explosion for Brute and Dark Knight.
 New console command for troubleshooting added.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Adjusted AI placements for golems on cave end tile and crystal cave tile.
 Added text to new game button on home page to explain save / settings reset.
 Fixed gap on dark fortress staircase tile.
 Added pachinko to dark fortress end tile.
 Fixed loot chests on dungeon cells tile.
 Increased most ammo pickups.
 Fix for pachinko machine balls escaping.
 Improved story loadscreen text.
 Smaller player nuke radius.
 Fix for secret ending load bug.

notes.title: Audio, Interface and Balance Update
notes.notes:
Adjustments made based on player feedback and observation ;)  It is a Demon Zoo out there!

Update Notes for ver. 051223

 Re-balanced game audio mixer.
 Added stray sounds to proper audio groups for revolver shells, iron gate, scroll rewards.
 Turned down home menu audio.
 Adjusted mouse cursor speed in home menu and player menus.
 Adjusted default audio / sensitivity settings slightly.
 Mansion secret door HP reduced.
 Adjusted player default audio levels and sound group selections.
 Added corpse pile to crystal cave room.
 Nuclear SRM auto-detonates after 10 seconds if there is no collision w/ target.
 Cage/skeleton removed from study secret room.
 Health vending machine removed from sewer room tile.

notes.title: Patch Notes for ver. 051023
notes.notes: Quickfix to add new console commands to improve testing and demo recording.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 050923
notes.notes:
Laser attachment added to assault rifle.
 Replaced laser rifle sound effect.
 Improved maze weapon pickup.
 Adjusted shotgun projectile position.

notes.title: Patch Notes for ver. 050623
notes.notes:
Quick fixes for 050623 and 050623-2

 Gem chests no longer move to the player when activated to address issues with camera collision.
 Added chest pickup fx.
 Fixed issue where sniper muzzle was showing in aim zoom mode
 Adjusted bullet fx on revolver, shotgun and AR.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 050423
notes.notes:
Player Control Update


 Changed reload and kick behavior to disable firing and aiming actions during reload event.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 050223
notes.notes:
Balance and Visual Communication Update


 Player only has to roll once to put out fire status now.
 Demon HP reduced.
 Rage mode text size increased.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 050223
notes.notes:
Balance and Visual Communication Update


 Revolver removed from starting weapons. 
 Player base health increased.
 Explosive trap chest is now less likely.  
 Pachinko player use area increased.
 Decorations removed from sewer stairs tile.
 Nailed shut door blockers in the mansion.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 043023
notes.notes:
Changed player injured state to only last for 6 seconds.
 Added flaming corpse pile to mansion start tile driveway.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 042323
notes.notes:
Turned off automatic weapon switching when out of ammo.
 Syncronized rage mode text info panel duration with player rage duration to better communicate event length to player.
 Additional fix for invincible player in lava insta-kill.

notes.title: Patch Notes for ver. 042023
notes.notes: Hotfix for bug where an invincible enraged player would not immediately die if falling into lava.  Big thanks to Noe for catching this one!

notes.title: Patch Notes for ver. 040623
notes.notes: Hotfix for player kick collider bug related to hit reaction interrupting events.  Set hit reaction probability temporarily to zero and back during kick events to avoid conflicts.

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 041523
notes.notes:
Demon fireballs will now light the player on fire.
 Improved player fire damage effects.
 Fixed column in Dark Fort treasure room.

 Brute colliders adjusted to improve corpse freeze behavior.
